settings.title: 1. Information on this site
settings.body: The content on this site is general information only. It isn't medical advice and doesn't replace a consultation with your doctor, vet or pharmacist. Always talk to a health professional about your own situation.

settings.title: 2. Prescriptions
settings.body:
We only prepare compounded and prescription medicines on a valid Australian prescription from an authorised prescriber.

Paper prescriptions must reach us in original form before we can supply, unless the law allows otherwise. Electronic prescriptions can be sent by token.

Our pharmacists may decline to prepare or supply a medicine if, in their professional judgement, it isn't appropriate or safe to do so, or if they need more information from the prescriber.

Some medicines, including Schedule 8 medicines, have extra legal requirements for supply, collection and delivery. We'll tell you if these apply.

settings.title: 3. Quotes, prices and payment
settings.body:
Compounded medicines are priced individually. We'll give you a quote after a pharmacist reviews your prescription, and we won't start preparing until you accept it.

Prices for over-the-counter products are shown on the site in Australian dollars and include GST where it applies.

We may correct pricing errors before an order is confirmed.

Payment is taken at checkout for shop orders, or when you accept a quote for compounded orders.

settings.title: 4. Preparation times
settings.body: Most compounded medicines are ready within 1 to 2 business days of a valid prescription. Some take longer. These times are estimates, not guarantees, and we'll let you know if yours will be delayed.

settings.title: 5. Collection and delivery
settings.body:
You can collect from either clinic during opening hours. Photo ID may be required for some medicines.

Delivery fees and timeframes are shown at checkout. Delivery time is extra to preparation time.

Some medicines can't be posted, or need to be signed for. We'll tell you before you pay.

Check your order when it arrives and tell us if anything is wrong or damaged.

settings.title: 6. Returns and refunds
settings.body:
For safety reasons, we can't accept returns of medicines once they've left the pharmacy, including compounded medicines made for you.

If a product is faulty, damaged, or not what you ordered, contact us and we'll arrange a replacement or refund.

Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

settings.title: 7. Your account
settings.body: Keep your login details private. You're responsible for activity on your account, and you should tell us straight away if you think someone else has accessed it. Please keep your contact and delivery details up to date.

settings.title: 8. Liability
settings.body: To the extent the law allows, we aren't liable for indirect loss arising from your use of this site. This doesn't affect any guarantee or right you have under the Australian Consumer Law that can't be excluded.

settings.title: 9. Website content
settings.body: All text, images and logos on this site belong to CanMed Compounding Chemist or are used with permission. Please don't copy them without our written consent.

settings.title: 10. Privacy
settings.body: Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle your personal and health information.

settings.title: 11. Changes to these terms
settings.body: We may update these terms from time to time. The version on this page at the time of your order applies to that order.

settings.title: 12. Governing law
settings.body: These terms are governed by the laws of South Australia.
